description: This Java class 'EdgeUtils' provides utility methods for handling edge-related events, including mapping entity types to event types, constructing edge events, generating random positive integers, and creating error messages from exceptions.

classes.name: EdgeUtils
classes.description: A utility class for managing edge events, including mapping entity types to event types, constructing edge events, generating random numbers, and error message creation.

methods.name: nextPositiveInt
methods.description: Generates a random positive integer using ThreadLocalRandom.

methods.name: getEdgeEventTypeByEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves the EdgeEventType associated with a given EntityType.

methods.name: getEdgeEventActionTypeByActionType
methods.description: Retrieves the EdgeEventActionType associated with a given ActionType.

methods.name: constructEdgeEvent
methods.description: Constructs and returns an EdgeEvent object with specified parameters.

methods.name: createErrorMsgFromRootCauseAndStackTrace
methods.description: Creates an error message string from the root cause of a Throwable, including up to 10 stack trace elements.
